acme-dev: We're seeing streaming JSON responses cut off mid-object when using JSON mode + SSE through our edge proxy (Fastly). Parsers throw 'unexpected end of input' about 30% of the time. Happens on larger outputs.

alyssa: Ugh. Can you paste a raw snippet of the streamed bytes (curl -N or tcpdump) and a request id if you have one?

acme-dev: here's an excerpt from curl -N (note truncated end):
```
data: {"id":"resp_01","items":[{"text":"...","meta":{
data: {"id":"resp_01","items":[{"text":"partial","meta":{
```
No trailing }] or final event.

sam: Looks like the connection drops right after a chunk boundary. Do you see any 502/524 from the edge around the same time? Also, which feature are you using — SSE (text/event-stream) or chunked newline-delimited JSON?

acme-dev: We use SSE (Content-Type: text/event-stream). Edge logs show a 524/timeout for some of the failures. Direct-to-api (bypassing Fastly) the same request completes fine.

matthew: That points at the proxy timing out mid-stream. Fastly/NGINX sometimes terminate idle streaming if keepalive or read timeout is hit. Can you check proxy config: proxy_read_timeout / idle_timeout?

acme-dev: Our Fastly config had a 65s idle timeout. The stream had long gaps between tokens. We'll try increasing it.

ingrid: Also try disabling response buffering on the proxy (e.g., proxy_buffering off / fastly streaming). If the proxy buffers, it may chunk things oddly and cause partial flushes. On our side, we saw similar when proxies coalesced SSE frames and then reset.

sam: For repro steps for ENG: 1) client request to /v1/chat?mode=json-stream 2) force long think time server-side to create sparse tokens 3) route through Fastly with 65s idle timeout and buffering on -> observe early EOF. I'll try to spin up a minimal repro using our recommended edge config.

alyssa: Customer also attached request id: req_01EJZ7. Can ENG check API logs for that id to see if our origin closed first? If origin didn't close, it's definitely the edge/proxy.

matthew: On the api logs for req_01EJZ7 I see our backend returned a continuous stream until final event. No origin-side error. Attaching log snippets to the ticket.

acme-dev: We ran a quick test after bumping Fastly read timeout to 300s and disabling buffering; the same payload completed successfully twice. Looks like that fixes it.

ingrid: Ok great — we'll document proxy guidance: require long read timeout for streaming JSON/SSE, disable response buffering, ensure keep-alive on client/proxy. Also recommend a small periodic keepalive token from client if there are long gaps.

sam: I'll create a knowledge base entry and add an example Nginx/Fastly snippet:
```
# nginx
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;

# fastly (VCL) - ensure streaming and no response caching for this route
```

alyssa: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the customer with the workaround and mark the ticket with mitigation steps. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Created ticket INC-12345 for req_01EJZ7 and assigned to sam.
